poll_s.source: PROPOSED supervisor and file-follow polling interval

shutdown_grace_s.source: PROPOSED per-process-group SIGINT drain deadline, including rosbag flush

terminate_grace_s.source: PROPOSED per-process-group SIGTERM deadline before SIGKILL

launch_shutdown_grace_s.source: PROPOSED outer ROS launch grace; exceeds sequential child shutdown deadlines

max_event_bytes.source: PROPOSED maximum JSONL event size to bound a malformed or incomplete producer line
